rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It executed cancellations and a return without first confirming with the user, violating the “confirm every order-changing action before taking it” rule. Authentication is also questionable: the agent only did a name/ZIP lookup and proceeded, with no explicit user verification step shown. Additionally, the statement that all refunds will go to PayPal is not clearly supported for the canceled orders (only the return call specifies a PayPal payment_method_id). While the actions align with the user’s intent (cancel pending orders and return the watch only) and totals were provided, the lack of required confirmation (and weak authentication) means the request was not completed in line with policy.
